create.name: Minnesota Zen Meditation Center
create.bio:
Minnesota Zen Meditation Center is a Soto Zen community on the shore of Bde Maka Ska in Minneapolis. Dainin Katagiri Roshi came from California in 1972 at the invitation of a local group and taught there until his death in 1990; Shohaku Okumura then served for a time, followed as head teacher by Karen Sunna, Tim Burkett and Ted O'Toole. Ben Connelly, who began practising at the centre in 2001 and is the author of several books on Buddhist philosophy, is now its guiding teacher, supported by a large circle of transmitted priests, emeritus teachers and lay teachers. It is also a priest training centre.

Zazen is held most mornings and on some weekday evenings, with Saturday and Sunday programmes, and almost everything is offered in person and on Zoom. Newcomers start with a four-part drop-in introduction to Zen meditation, then move on to Beginner's Mind retreats, days of practice, weekend sesshins and the eight-day Rohatsu sesshin in December. Study classes and practice periods run through the year, and every programme is offered on a donation basis. The centre keeps an archive of Sunday talks and a collection of Katagiri Roshi's recorded lectures.

courses.title: Introduction to Zen Meditation
courses.description: A four-part drop-in series held on Sunday mornings and Tuesday evenings, in the classroom and on Zoom, combining meditation instruction with teaching on the Four Noble Truths, the bodhisattva way, studying the self and mindfulness. The parts can be taken in any order and no registration is needed.

courses.title: Beginner's Mind Retreat, November
courses.description: An afternoon retreat for people new to extended sitting, led by lay teacher Deb Mielke, with periods of sitting and walking meditation in a contemporary format without formal ritual.

courses.title: Learn the Basics of Zen Forms and Etiquette
courses.description: A short in-person class for a group of up to twelve covering bows, entering and leaving the zendo and walking meditation, so that newcomers feel at ease joining morning zazen or a sesshin.

courses.title: Rohatsu Sesshin with Ben Connelly and Tim Burkett
courses.description: The centre's traditional December sesshin marking the Buddha's awakening, led by its guiding teacher and a former head teacher: zazen alternating with walking meditation, liturgy, formal oryoki meals and private interviews with a teacher. Registration is asked for a week ahead.

courses.title: Daily Meditation (Zazen)
courses.description: The weekly schedule of silent seated and walking meditation with morning service, on weekday mornings, Monday and Wednesday evenings, Tuesday evenings with a talk, and Saturday and Sunday mornings, in the zendo or on Zoom.
courses.price: Open to the public by donation

free_resources.title: Sunday Talk Archive
free_resources.description: Recordings of the weekly Sunday Dharma talks by the centre's guiding teacher, priests and lay teachers, each available to play or download as an MP3.

free_resources.title: The Dainin Katagiri Audio Archive
free_resources.description: Lectures by the centre's founder, Dainin Katagiri Roshi, recorded in the 1980s and shared as downloadable audio files, including series on Dogen's writings.

free_resources.title: Chants and Services
free_resources.description: The texts used in the centre's morning and Saturday services, with a downloadable chant book for following along in person or at home.
